samples.summary: Lessons doc names a function 'removeCellNodeStyle' that does not exist in the code; the actual (and more general) function is 'removeNodeStyle'.
samples.evidence: docs/tasks/active/20260812-docs-font-color-reset-lessons.md states: 'Yorkie has no single-node removal, so removeCellNodeStyle drops to the index API and removes over [pathToIndex(cell), +1) — the cell's opening tag alone.' The actual function in packages/frontend/src/app/docs/yorkie-doc-store.ts:273 is `removeNodeStyle(tree, path, attrsToRemove)`, a shared helper also used for block-level style removal, not a cell-specific function named removeCellNodeStyle.
